ad_final_urls.description: Final URLs for the Ad. Stored as a JSON string.

ad_final_urls_parsed.description: ad_final_urls with each short link resolved to its landing page; other URLs stay unchanged. Requires ad_final_urls and Process Short Links. Stored as a JSON string.

ad_group_id.description: ID of the ad group the row belongs to. FK to [Ad Groups](./ad-groups.md)

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign the row belongs to.

impressions.description: Times the ad appeared on a search results page or a website on the Google Network.

clicks.description: Clicks on the ads; `ctr` is clicks divided by impressions.

conversions.description: Conversions from the actions counted in the Conversions column (include_in_conversions_metric on), the ones conversion-based bidding optimizes for; `all_conversions` adds the rest.

conversions_value.description: Value of `conversions`: only the actions counted in the Conversions column (include_in_conversions_metric on); `all_conversions_value` adds the rest.

cost_per_conversion.description: Cost of ad interactions divided by `conversions`, so it counts only the actions included in the Conversions column.

conversion_rate.description: Conversions from interactions divided by `interactions` (Google Ads `conversions_from_interactions_rate`); counts only the actions included in `conversions`.

view_through_conversions.description: Conversions by people who saw an image or rich media ad and later converted on the site without interacting with another ad.

all_conversions.description: Conversions from every conversion action, including those not counted in `conversions` (include_in_conversions_metric off).

all_conversions_value.description: Value of `all_conversions`: every conversion action, including those not counted in `conversions_value`.

average_cost.description: Average amount paid per interaction: the total cost divided by `interactions`.

interactions.description: The main user action for the ad format: clicks for text and shopping ads, views for video ads, and so on.

search_budget_lost_impression_share.description: Estimated share of the Search impressions the ads missed because the budget was too low, from 0 to 0.9; anything above 0.9 is reported as 0.9001.

search_rank_lost_impression_share.description: Estimated share of the Search impressions the ads missed because of poor Ad Rank, from 0 to 0.9; anything above 0.9 is reported as 0.9001.

video_view_rate.description: TrueView views divided by impressions, including thumbnail impressions for TrueView in-display ads (Google Ads `video_trueview_view_rate`).

campaign_id.description: The campaign's ID, the key of this table; every other table except Geo Target Constants carries it to point here.

campaign_start_date.description: The day the campaign started serving, in the account's time zone.

campaign_end_date.description: The last day the campaign serves, in the account's time zone.

criterion_id.description: ID of the criterion; unique only together with `ad_group_id` and `campaign_id`, which complete the key.

keyword_text.description: The text of the keyword, at most 80 characters and 10 words.
